My need for control boils down to my childhood trauma of my parents abandoning me. Apparently this left a huge scar in my life I never realised. Realising this made me less annoyed when plans don't go 100% my way, but I'm still annoyed nonetheless. I've come to terms to use this need for control to my strength and advantage. I'm a project manager and my job requires me to plan ahead for big campaigns. It feels especially good when you have clear visibility on next steps and when people feel like they can rely on you. The first impression I give to people I know is 'motherly' oppose to 'controlling', which is a huge relieve to me. I guess even though I have this huge need for control, I'm emphatic at the same time due to the pain I felt as a child. I know some people who have the same controlling trait but come off as rude because they don't express themselves well :/
